purpose: Prospectively test whether original Orc native HDC/KAN/SSM and portable selection improve matched causal meteorological forecasts; avoid historical retrospective availability proxy
frozen_before_any_new_site_data: R5 source/venue/method/cohort specification to be committed before any prospective collection or model fit; earlier R3/R4 source/result familiarity disclosed

prospective_data.replacements: no substitutions even if all forecasts refuse
prospective_data.required_response: HTTP 200 JSON list; strict UTF-8 and source SHA-256; preserve exact HTTP bytes, status, URL and Date response header
prospective_data.collection_activation: explicit separate authorization and real witness artifact provisioning required; not silently started by this preregistration
prospective_data.fixed_window: 28 contiguous full UTC days = 672 hourly buckets
prospective_data.start_alignment: first 00:00 UTC strictly AFTER both independent witness lanes have produced and externally anchored one valid initial capture; never backdate
prospective_data.target_observation_time: must be strictly later than issue timestamp, and target observed in its exact later hourly bucket
prospective_data.conversion: Kelvin = source numeric temp + 273.15, original numerical source retained unrounded
prospective_data.same_hour_multiple_reports: mark ambiguous and refuse entire station-hour, including later corrected observations; retain all raw variants
prospective_data.late_or_revised_observation: first anchored exact raw report required; later modified or corrected station-hour disqualifies the hour rather than rewriting history

witnesses.external_anchor: for each exact raw HTTP response and capture record, separately verify GitHub Actions immutable artifact ID, source run ID, object SHA256, artifact created_at, original run/job and trusted server recorded timestamp; never trust artifact ID or timestamp embedded by uploader without external lookup
witnesses.admissibility_for_forecast_origin: same exact observation identity and unchanged raw report witnessed by both A and B; both external artifact creation UTC timestamps <= issue time; original HTTP source bytes verified per artifact; both claims capture start <= completion <= external artifact creation
witnesses.first_available_proof: first observed and externally anchored by THESE two observers, not the instant it first existed worldwide
witnesses.trusted_server_time_limit: independent external GitHub artifact created_at <= issue, not just runner clock or NOAA receiptTime
witnesses.noncaptured_intervals: retain explicit no-observation/error/gap receipts with sequence, never assume observations existed
witnesses.witness_pair_independence: two separate native executions/archives; independently verify distinct run IDs, artifact IDs and capture lanes; same provider upstream is correlated; do not claim independent weather sources
witnesses.minimum_end_to_end_source_window: all train/cal/test full UTC 672 hours with every poll recorded or explicit gap flag and monotone witness sequences; missing intervals are refusals, not backfilled
witnesses.external_anchored_hash_chain: each lane chained immutable per-poll canonical JSON record SHA256 to prior record; verifier checks every predecessor and global sequence without omissions; anchors independently tied to externally indexed artifacts; first-seen claims refuse earlier missing or gap intervals

models.primary_reference: direct_ridge prior accepted fixed registration; original methods and weights code pinned at independent execution
models.if_new_models_proposed: separate prereg new independent future data; never mutate this protocol or original R4 report

scientific_metrics.primary_metric: equal-weight macro of per-site/per-horizon signed fractional test RMSE gain versus registered direct ridge, requiring all 9 site-horizon cells, not a selective evaluated-only mean
secondary_metrics: relative computational cost (measured native duration separately from model error)
scientific_metrics.time_dependence: fixed 6-hour disjoint chronological blocks, bootstrap 256 seeds with seed 5506; intervals denied if fewer than 4 blocks
scientific_metrics.coverage_abstention: report all refused cases/origins; incomplete model has no full-9 macro, no silent partial win
scientific_metrics.first_prospective_acceptance_requirement: at least 4 eligible contiguous 6-hour blocks per task, else report insufficient evidence, no significance claims
scientific_metrics.exploratory_multiplicity: no p-value or general superiority without prereg multiplicity correction and genuine independent replication
scientific_metrics.holdout_firewall: record signed or externally anchored train/cal predictions and selected method prior to any held-out target scoring; evaluator requires frozen decision manifest

execution.CI_policy: manual-only source preflight; no scheduled continuous CI or Docker; prospective collection separately authorized and durable
execution.security: host operator authorizes network fetch and preservation; no secret exfiltration, explicit fixed NOAA destination, host permission separate from scientific data
